name: Device Rejoin and Catch-Up
description: A device that has been offline catches up efficiently. Differential sync, not full resync.
purpose: Ensure devices that reconnect after being offline catch up efficiently via differential sync rather than full state resynchronization.
acceptanceCriteria: Rejoining device sends its last-known vector clock or sequence number.
Server computes the minimal set of missed operations.
Only missed operations are replayed, not the full state.
If missed operation count exceeds a threshold, a snapshot transfer is used instead.
Rejoin is atomic from the device's perspective — failure mid-rejoin leaves it in a recoverable state.
Progress is reported during long catch-up syncs.
